corrections.why: The list codes this tower gfc-333, a number from an older GFC list. The US prefix in the record does not appear in that code.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one source, the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (map revised March 2016), plus the NHLR Georgia list, which does not name this tower. Searches and register pages found nothing on build date, design, staffing, fate or current status. The gfc-333 code is only a pointer to an older GFC list; that list was not found online. The record's 'US 333' looks like an error, hence the proposed correction. The elevation unit is not printed; it is read as feet (503 ft = 153.3 m matches elevation_m). The name is the compiler's label. Neighbour Kathleen (gfc-334, GA031 on the same list) is on the NHLR as the Oaky Woods (Kathleen) Fire Tower, built circa 1950; it is a different tower and is not used here. A search snippet gives Henderson as a Houston County community, which may or may not be the source of the name; it was not read, so not cited.
